result.stdout:
Description:
  Didot Command Line Interface

Usage:
  Didot [options]

Options:
  -t, --template <template> (REQUIRED)       Path to the template file.
  -e, --engine <engine>                      The template engine to use or to enforce when rendering the template.
  -x, --engine-extension <engine-extension>  Associate a file's extension to a specific template engine.
  -s, --source <source>                      The source file(s) to use when rendering the template. The key is an optional identifier for the source that can be used in the template to reference it. If only one source file is provided without a key, it will be associated with an empty string key. This option cannot be used together with --stdin.
  -i, --stdin                                Indicates that the input will come from stdin.
  -r, --parser <parser>                      The parser to use when reading from StdIn or to enforce when reading from files.
  -X, --parser-extension <parser-extension>  Associate a file's extension to a specific parser.
  -P, --parser-parameter <parser-parameter>  Provide key-value parameters for parsers, such as configuration or dialect settings.
  -o, --output <output>                      Path to the output file. If not provided, the rendered template will be written to stdout.
  -?, -h, --help                             Show help and usage information
  --version                                  Show version information
